arxiv-2102-04598.title: Isolated subgroups of finite abelian groups
arxiv-2102-04598.creator: Marius Tărnăuceanu
arxiv-2102-04598.description: Abstract We say that a subgroup H H is isolated in a group G G if for every x ∈ G x\in G we have either x ∈ H x\in H or ⟨ x ⟩ ∩ H = 1 \langle x\rangle\cap H=1 . In this short note, we describe the set of isolated subgroups of a finite abelian group.

arxiv-2209-00712.title: Lattice Size in Higher Dimension Thanks: Work of Chakravarty, Kaplan, and Soprunova was partially supported by NSF Grant DMS-1653002
arxiv-2209-00712.creator: Abdulrahman Alajmi, Sayok Chakravarty, Zachary Kaplan, Jenya Soprunova
arxiv-2209-00712.description: Abstract . The lattice size of a lattice polytope is a geometric invariant which was formally introduced in the context of simplification of the defining equation of an algebraic curve, but appeared implicitly earlier in geometric combinatorics. Previous work on the lattice size was devoted to studying the lattice size in dimension 2 and 3.

arxiv-2307-03358.title: Niobate-on-Niobate Resonators with Aluminum Electrodes
arxiv-2307-03358.creator: Yiyang Feng, Sen Dai, Sunil Bhave
arxiv-2307-03358.description: Abstract In this work, we have successfully engineered and examined suspended laterally vibrating resonators (LVRs) on a lithium niobate thin film on lithium niobate carrier wafer (LN-on-LN) platform, powered by aluminum interdigital transducers (IDTs). Unlike the lithium niobate-on-silicon system, the LN-on-LN platform delivers a stress-neutral lithium niobate thin film exhibiting the quality of bulk single crystal.

arxiv-2307-06865.title: Effective Prompt Extraction from Language Models
arxiv-2307-06865.creator: Yiming Zhang, Nicholas Carlini, Daphne Ippolito
arxiv-2307-06865.description: Abstract The text generated by large language models is commonly controlled by prompting , where a prompt prepended to a user’s query guides the model’s output. The prompts used by companies to guide their models are often treated as secrets, to be hidden from the user making the query.

arxiv-2309-02258.title: On 3 3 -Coloring Circle Graphs Thanks: Funded by the Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (German Research Foundation, DFG) under grant RU-1903/3-1. Affiliation: Faculty of Informatics and Mathematics, University of Passau, Germany E-mail {bachmanp,rutter,stumpf}@fim.uni-passau.de
arxiv-2309-02258.creator: Patricia Bachmann, Ignaz Rutter, Peter Stumpf
arxiv-2309-02258.description: Abstract Given a graph G G with a fixed vertex order ≺ \prec , one obtains a circle graph H H whose vertices are the edges of G G and where two such edges are adjacent if and only if their endpoints are pairwise distinct and alternate in ≺ \prec .

arxiv-2504-06327.title: Physics-informed KAN PointNet: Deep learning for simultaneous solutions to inverse problems in incompressible flow on numerous irregular geometries
arxiv-2504-06327.creator: Ali Kashefi, Tapan Mukerji
arxiv-2504-06327.description: Abstract Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) have gained attention as a promising alternative to traditional Multilayer Perceptrons (MLPs) for deep learning applications in computational physics, especially within the framework of physics-informed neural networks (PINNs). Physics-informed Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (PIKANs) and their variants have been introduced and evaluated to solve inverse problems.

arxiv-2506-06981.title: Deep RL Needs Deep Behavior Analysis: Exploring Implicit Planning by Model-Free Agents in Open-Ended Environments
arxiv-2506-06981.creator: Riley Simmons-Edler, Ryan P. Badman, Felix Baastad Berg, Raymond Chua, John J. Vastola, Joshua Lunger, William Qian, Kanaka Rajan
arxiv-2506-06981.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Riley Simmons-Edler, Ryan P. Badman, Felix Baastad Berg, Raymond Chua, John J. Vastola, Joshua Lunger, William Qian, Kanaka Rajan. Understanding the behavior of deep reinforcement learning (DRL) agents—particularly as task and agent sophistication increase—requires more than simple comparison of reward curves, yet standard methods for behavioral analysis remain underdeveloped in DRL.

arxiv-2512-10097.title: Enabling searches for long-lived particles at a future 10 TeV Muon Collider arXiv: 1234.56789
arxiv-2512-10097.creator: M. Littmann, M. Larson, B. Rosser, T. Flicker, K. Huang, L. Rozanov, and K. F. Di Petrillo
arxiv-2512-10097.description: Abstract Muon Colliders offer fantastic opportunities to explore new phenomena at the energy frontier. However, beam-induced-backgrounds from muon decays pose significant challenges for detector design, readout, and reconstruction. Previous detector studies have employed stringent hit-timing requirements to reduce occupancy to manageable levels with negligible efficiency loss for prompt Standard Model particles.

britannica-1911-alarcon-pedro-antonio-de.title: Alarcón, Pedro Antonio de (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-alarcon-pedro-antonio-de.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-alarcon-pedro-antonio-de.description: Article 'Alarcón, Pedro Antonio de' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 1), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. writer, was born on the 10th of March 1833 at Guadix. He graduated at the university of Granada, studied law and theology privately, and made his first appearance as a dramatist before he was of age. Deciding to follow literature as a profession, he joined with Torcuato Tárrago y Mateos in editing a Cadiz newspaper entitled El Eco de Occidente.

europmc-pmc3994286.title: Interleukin 12: still a promising candidate for tumor immunotherapy?
europmc-pmc3994286.creator: Lasek W, Zagożdżon R, Jakobisiak M.
europmc-pmc3994286.description: Interleukin 12 (IL-12) seemed to represent the ideal candidate for tumor immunotherapy, due to its ability to activate both innate (NK cells) and adaptive (cytotoxic T lymphocytes) immunities. However, despite encouraging results in animal models, very modest antitumor effects...

pmc-11368313.title: Mental health and well-being amongst adolescents in today’s times
pmc-11368313.creator: Pramita Muntode Gharde, Sonali Choudhari
pmc-11368313.description: ealth disorders are emotional disorders, behavioural disorders, risk-taking behaviours, self-harm, suicidal tendencies, eating disorders, and coping disorders.[23] Adolescents must develop social and emotional habits which can assist them in coping skills. Poor mental health is associated with domestic violence, child abuse, bullying, peer pressure, substance abuse, human immunodeficiency virus infection, and teenage pregnancy.

pmc-11536015.title: Xylooligosaccharide interferes with the cell cycle and reduces the antibiotic tolerance of avian pathogenic Escherichia coli by associating with its potential antimetabolic actions
pmc-11536015.creator: Lulu Ren, Hui Ye, Jiarong Fang, Qingyun Cao, Changming Zhang, Zemin Dong, Dingyuan Feng, Jianjun Zuo, Weiwei Wang
pmc-11536015.description: This study aimed to probe if xylooligosaccharide (XOS) could act as an antimetabolite to impact the cell cycle and antibiotic tolerance of avian pathogenic Escherichia coli (APEC). We firstly measured the bacteriostasis of XOS against APEC O78 and its effect on the growth of APEC O78 growing on different medium.

pmc-11677084.title: Adsorption and Removal of 2,4,6-Trinitrotoluene by a Glycoluril-Derived Molecular-Clip-Based Supramolecular Organic Framework
pmc-11677084.creator: Yuezhou Liu, Shu Zeng, Xiaokai He, Yang Wu, Yang Liu, Yinglei Wang, Barbara Bonelli
pmc-11677084.description: A glycoluril-derived molecular-clip-based supramolecular organic framework (clip-SOF) with intrinsic porosity was prepared. The clip-SOF was used for the adsorption and removal of 2,4,6-trinitrotoluene (TNT) driven by noncovalent interactions. The efficiency of TNT removal by clip-SOFs is up to 88.5% in adsorption equilibrium, and the TNT adsorption capacity of clip-SOFs is about 40.2 mg/g at 25.0 °C.

pmc-11692665.title: COMPARE FRAILTY IN OLDER ADULTS AND NONOLDER ADULTS WITH HEART FAILURE
pmc-11692665.creator: Jenny Hsieh, Pi-Ling Chou
pmc-11692665.description: Frailty is commonly presented among patients with chronic diseases, including heart failure(HF), leading to poor prognosis. However, the association between age and frailty in patients with HF remains unclear. Therefore, our study aims to compare the difference in frailty status in older and non-older adults with chronic HF symptoms.

pmc-12352544.title: Poverty Reduction and Family Functioning: Results from an Experimental Study in Sub-Saharan Africa
pmc-12352544.creator: Leyla Karimli, Josephine Nabayinda, Portia B. Nartey, Fred M. Ssewamala
pmc-12352544.description: The study tests the effect of poverty-reduction intervention on family functioning reported by AIDS-orphaned children in extended families in Southern Uganda by asking two questions: (1) based on children’s reports, how does poverty reduction intervention affect family functioning? and (2) to what extent do these effects vary by a child’s gender and orphanhood status?

pmc-12587416.title: Enhanced protocol for measuring glutathione peroxidase activity using a new glutathione peroxidase-Tiron assay
pmc-12587416.creator: Mahmoud Hussein Hadwan, Abbas Ali Mohammed, Saeed Najavand, Roaa Altaee, Asad M Hadwan
pmc-12587416.description: Conventional methods for measuring glutathione peroxidase (GPx) activity are limited by interference issues, complex protein precipitation steps, and variable reliability, necessitating the development of improved analytical approaches for both research and clinical applications. A modified GPx activity assay has been developed utilizing the Tiron reagent system, which eliminates the need for protein precipitation.

pmc-12622427.title: Direct Observation of Intrinsic Spin–Layer Coupling and Robust Valley Polarization in Bilayer MoS2
pmc-12622427.creator: Yumin Sim, Je‐Ho Lee, Nguyen T. Hoang, No‐Won Park, Sang‐Kwon Lee, Maeng‐Je Seong
pmc-12622427.description: Herein, direct evidence of intrinsic spin–layer coupling in bilayer MoS2 through polarization‐resolved photoluminescence measurements on fully suspended samples is presented. By eliminating substrate‐induced symmetry breaking, such as electrostatic potential gradients and unintentional strain, the intrinsic valley dynamics of bilayer MoS2 is isolated.

pmc-13267142.description: As a key species in China's ecologically fragile Sanjiangyuan region, Juniperus tibetica faces severe threats from Arceuthobium oxycedri. pmc-13296061.title: Imidazo[2,1-b][1,3,4]thiadiazol-2-yl]-1H-pyrrolo[2,3-b]pyridines as Inhibitors of Staphylococcus aureus Biofilm Formation
pmc-13296061.creator: Domenico Schillaci, Fabiana Plescia, Fabio Scianò, Federica Parisi, Valentina Catania, Barbara Manachini, Serena Indelicato, Tania Ciaglia, Anna Di Dio, Stella Cascioferro
pmc-13296061.description: Background/Objectives: Biofilm-related infections represent a major concern in clinical practice because of their poor responsiveness to standard antimicrobial treatments. Over the past decade, many efforts have been made to identify new compounds capable of inhibiting this particularly resistant form of bacterial life. Although several compounds have shown interesting anti-biofilm properties, none have reached the clinic.

pmc-13358271.title: Between help and hindrance: a qualitative study on inclusion of birth companions in closed, invited and contested spaces within maternity care settings in Malawi
pmc-13358271.creator: Bianca Kandeya, Wanangwa Chimwaza, Claudia Hanson, Dorcus Kiwanuka Henriksson, William Stones, Effie Chipeta, Helle Mølsted Alvesson
pmc-13358271.description: BackgroundBirth companionship is widely recognised as a key component of respectful maternity care, with well-documented benefits for maternal and neonatal outcomes. However, in low-resource settings like Malawi, its integration into facility-based care remains limited and uneven due to systemic, infrastructural and interpersonal challenges.

pmc-13499109.title: Bundibugyo ebolavirus emergence in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo: The critical role of risk communication and community engagement in strengthening health security in fragile and conflict-affected settings
pmc-13499109.creator: Elie Kihanduka, Christian Tague, Saralees Nadarajah, Excellent Rugendabanga, Aymar Akilimali, Beni Muyisa, Nathan Mugenyi, Pauline Byakika-Kibwika
pmc-13499109.description: Since mid-May 2026, a rapidly evolving Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain (Orthoebolavirus bundibugyoense) has been spreading in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri, North and South Kivu provinces) and Uganda (Kampala and Wakiso areas). Uganda has so far reported 14 imported cases and 5 secondary transmissions according to the World Health Organization (WHO).
